Challenge 2 (MAST, zero-shot): new conv net over a 5-channel machine-agnostic spatial input built from each shot's own geometry: a coil-only vacuum flux map (real Green's-function calculation, same formula both machines, zero MAST-specific fitting), CoordConv R/Z channels, a core-Thomson pressure profile, and a broadcast Ip channel. Predicts the plasma's residual on top of the vacuum field plus q95/βN heads. Trained only on DIII-D; no MAST labels used anywhere (rule 3). Held-out DIII-D val: shape R² 0.83, log-amp R² 0.74, q95 R² 0.93, βN R² 0.94 — vs. the prior linear baseline's ~0.08. ~1.3 GPU-hours (Colab). Total: ~5 GPU-hours.  Disclosures: this Ch2 variant was selected via comparison of this team's own prior Development-phase S_MAST scores (0.0276 → 0.0575), per rule 3 — no MAST equilibrium data used in training or selection.
